newsitem.title: USA: Freighter slams into New Orleans Riverwalk, four dead.
newsitem.headline: Freighter slams into New Orleans Riverwalk, four dead.

text.p: A freighter slammed into a crowded riverfront casino and shopping area on Saturday, killing at least four people and injuring dozens more, authorities said.
The New Orleans Riverwalk was heavily damaged when the Liberian-registered freighter MV Brightfield slammed into the elevated strip of expensive stores overlooking the Mississippi River.
Patrons had some warning and were racing away from the waterfront when the massive ship hit the concrete seawall, crushing the walls of many stores.

The Coast Guard said the Brightfield apparently lost power as it moved under a bridge near downtown New Orleans and hit the Riverwalk, adjacent to the downtown Hilton Hotel about 2:15 p.m. (CST) (3:15 p.m. EST).
The ship's crew were helpless to stop the vessel, but sounded a warning siren and the ship's horn repeatedly as the freighter moved inexorably toward the Riverwalk.

Police said three bodies were recovered and the Coast Guard was searching for one body in the water. A three-alarm fire broke out in the shattered shopping mall shortly after the crash, a fire department spokeswoman said.
"Details are still sketchy, but initial reports indicate at least part of the Riverwalk collapsed," a Coast Guard spokesman told Reuters. "There are casualties, several dozen."
No injuries were reported on board the ship, which was holed and was leaking, he said.
New Orleans is one of the busiest U.S. shipping ports.
